notes: P1 alternative: #2 Merian 1633 (large, black and white, Swedish boat bridge and camp); B&H preferred for color. #13 (1657, Janssonius) re-issues Merian’s 1646 landward view; #11 (1726) is a copy; #21 (1759 optical print) copies the 1572 skyline. #15 Schütz is dated only by the painter’s life (1718–91). #16 is an event view (after the 1793 siege) and can be dropped if only ordinary views are wanted. #39 (2019 riverfront at dusk) is an alternative for P6 but does not show the cathedral.
